pr_body:
In #73551 we changed how we wrap exception in the transport handler. This make this test fail as the error message has changed slightly. This PR adjust the test to the new situation and it actually removes some randomisation so both paths the test is checking are run every time.

fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/75209
